findings.what: The header groups modes 12, 7, and 14 as selecting specialized steering calls. Modes 12 and 7 select returning steering helpers, but mode 14 conditionally calls func_01b078 and then still uses ordinary func_01af04 steering. The inspected func_01b078 only tests status, invokes another routine, and sets a byte flag; it neither writes motion nor returns a specialized steering direction. This is comment precision only; the implementation matches the original.
